title: What I received is super large and does not have vented lids as specified but it's functional
text:
What I received is super large and does not have vented lids as specified but it's functional. I ordered this because the XL shape of these was supposed to be more taller than long. Also the lids were supposed to be vented. Even though this is a great set, it is not what is advertised.

Note that I already have two of the smaller long containers and they are fantastic for holding soups and then squeezing it into the fridge on top of other stuff as a result of the low profile size (meaning not that tall). The larger bin is large enough to store a pair of boots and is great for holding batches of cookies, pasta, etc.

I would have rated this 1 star because it was not what I ordered. Nevertheless, this does not take away from the functionality or quality of this set even if it is not as advertised. Note that it is a bit difficult to secure the lids and they fasten tightly. If it were as advertised, I would have given this 4 or 5 stars.
